surface_mechanism_description: Exchange reactions in the surface very similar to those observed for Ta205 give rise to the growth of a ZnS film. The reactions release chemisorbed CI in the surface as HCl vapor and form a solid layer of oxygen which is bonded to the monoatomic Ta layer underneath. The reactions are perfect leaving no detectable traces of CI in the surface (when grown in vacuum) and that they occur in the outermost atomic layer of the film.
